recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white urban portrait featuring a man in a wide-brimmed hat and long leather coat, positioned centrally against a textured city storefront. The composition is bisected by a horizontal typographic bar that creates a layered depth effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's leather texture vs. the gritty stone architecture
Horizontal text bar vs. vertical lines of the iron fence
High-contrast lighting defining the subject's facial features
Foreground subject scale vs. the receding urban background
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject
Central vertical alignment of the figure
Presence of a semi-transparent horizontal graphic band

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally framed, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hat, highlighted by the strongest light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down the reflective leather coat, then follows the horizontal text bar across the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and the lower street area provide dark, textured negative space that pushes the subject forward.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and shadows providing structural depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the architectural background and coat highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for typographic elements and sharp specular highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the white text and the dark clothing.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Primary name is rendered in a semi-transparent gray to allow background textures to show through
Secondary text is solid white for maximum legibility
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast within the same sans-serif family.
graphicDevices: Abstract geometric icon (four-bar motif) to the left of the text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, urban weight and square terminals.
Provides the clean, neutral geometric structure required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a man in a black fedora and a long, shiny leather trench coat standing in front of a gritty New York brownstone storefront with an iron fence.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a horizontal semi-transparent dark gray bar across the middle. Place bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif text on the bar, using white for the smaller title and semi-transparent light gray for the larger name.

verificationChecks: Does the text bar bisect the subject's torso?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep blacks?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the leather coat's sheen
Transparency level of the horizontal bar
Specific urban architectural details in the background
postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black and white without color cast
Verify the subject's hat is not cropped
Confirm the leather texture is visible in the highlights
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + High Contrast B&W + Geometric Sans-Serif Overlay + Horizontal Bisection
